_comment: A critique of a plaza that genuinely clears the gate. Pair with metrics-good-plaza.json. Not a perfect scene — several 2s and 3s — but no hard fails and a weighted mean above 2.6/4.

composition.justification: Top view shows the fountain off-centre on a third, with benches grouped in threes and planters breaking the perimeter rhythm.

focal_point.justification: The fountain dominates hero at roughly twice the lamp height, framed by the arch and lit brighter than its surroundings.

proportion_scale.justification: Eye view reads correctly against a character: bench seats near 2.5 studs, arch clearance around 12 studs.

silhouette.justification: Front view outlines are varied — tapered lamp posts, a stepped fountain basin, trees with irregular canopies.

material_coherence.justification: Slate paving, WoodPlanks benches, Metal lamp fittings and Water in the basin all read as the right substance in hero.

material_variety.justification: Histogram shows six materials with meaningful area, including Water and Neon used sparingly.

palette_discipline.justification: Warm grey paving dominates with two greens and a single copper accent repeated on the lamps and fountain rim.

value_structure.justification: Dark planting beds, mid-tone paving and the pale fountain stone give three clear value groups in hero.

lighting_setup.justification: ClockTime, Ambient and Brightness all tuned; 14 lights placed at the lamp heads plus one uplighting the fountain.

atmosphere_mood.justification: Atmosphere and SunRays configured, late-afternoon colour temperature; the eye view feels like a time of day.

edge_trim_finish.justification: Border course around the paving and caps on the lamp posts, but bench-to-ground junctions are still raw seams.

surface_detail_density.justification: 311 parts under 2 studs: paving joints, bench slats, lamp bolts, densest around the fountain.

prop_layering.justification: Architecture, furniture and dressing all present; litter bins and planters clustered rather than evenly spread.

negative_space.justification: Open floor held clear for about 20 studs around the fountain with density pushed to the perimeter.

vertical_variation.justification: Four height tiers visible in front: paving, bench, lamp, fountain spire, plus a spanning arch overhead.

spatial_flow.justification: Top view shows four radial paths into the square with marked thresholds and comfortable widths.

ground_treatment.justification: Paved surface with a radial inlay ring, a border course and separate Grass planting beds — no baseplate visible.

scene_cohesion.justification: Consistent stone-and-copper town language across paving, lamps, benches and fountain in all four views.

prompt_fidelity.justification: A town square with a centrepiece, seating, planting and lighting, arranged to actually feel welcoming.

technical_hygiene.justification: 946 parts, all anchored, grouped into named models, no z-fighting visible at any viewpoint.

defects.detail: bench legs meet paving with no base plate or shadow-catching trim

observedLandmark: the tiered stone fountain at the centre-right of the square
summary: A stone-and-copper town square with a tiered fountain as its centrepiece, paved with a radial inlay and framed by planting and lamp posts. The weakest area is trim: several furniture-to-ground junctions are still raw seams.
